independent_computation.step_1_resource: Syndra's casting resource is MANA, so resource_cost for any cast entry is that ability's mana cost at its current rank.
independent_computation.step_2_rank_table: Rank distribution at the corpus's standard level 18: 18 skill points = 5/5/5 on the basics + 3 on the ultimate. So Q = rank 5, W = rank 5, E = rank 5, R = rank 3.
independent_computation.step_4_admissible_values: The only correct resource_cost values anywhere in a level-18 Syndra cast timeline are {50, 60, 100}. 100 is correct for a Force of Will or an Unleashed Power cast; 60 is correct only for a Dark Sphere cast (Q or the Q2 charge).
step_5_which_reading_explains_60_to_100: Reading A (same ability, corrected rank): 60 and 100 are exactly the first and last entries of ONE array - Force of Will's [60, 70, 80, 90, 100]. A cast that keeps its identity and moves from 60 to 100 is a Force of Will priced at rank 1 before and rank 5 after. At level 18 W is unambiguously rank 5, so 100 is the correct value and 60 was a rank-index defect. No other Syndra ability can produce the pair (60, 100) from its own cost array.

Reading B (order changed, so a different ability now sits at index 4): index 4 is the last of the five casts; under the new order it is a W or an R cast (100), under the old order it was a Q or Q2 cast (60). Both are individually well-formed prices, so this reading alone cannot rule either way - but it also gives no mechanism by which a Dark Sphere cast could ever be charged 100, whereas it does explain a 100-cost ability landing at the tail.

Synthesis: Reading A uniquely and exactly reproduces the observed (60 -> 100) pair from the cached cost table and points to 100. Reading B is neutral. There is no mechanism in the cached data by which 100 could be a wrong price for any cast that legitimately occupies index 4, while 60 is reproducible as a rank-1 defect. Therefore 100 is the defensible value.
step_6_ruled_out: W's free recast: the wiki text prices the initial grab only ('Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held'), so a recast entry would read 0.0, not 60.0 or 100.0. Neither value is the recast, so this is not a recast-pricing question.
Passive mana restore ('Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores 20 : 255 (based on level) mana') is a resource gain, not a cast cost, and never nets against resource_cost.
No Transcendent bonus at any splinter threshold (40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120) alters a mana cost; they alter charges, true damage, scatter angle, execute and AP.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition for 'syndra_custom_order_60' lives outside the permitted evidence tree (no file under data/ or docs/math-foundations.md contains 'custom_order', 'cast_timeline' or 'resource_cost'), so the identity of the ability at cast_timeline[4] could not be read directly. The verdict rests on the cost table above plus the fact that (60, 100) is precisely Force of Will's rank-1/rank-5 pair. The only world in which the old value is correct is one where index 4 is a Dark Sphere cast (Q or Q2) that the change re-priced at 100 - and the cached data offers no mechanism that would ever charge a Dark Sphere 100 mana.
